key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often to scan for listening ports (in seconds)

key.name: include-udp
key.description: Include UDP sockets in addition to TCP

key.description: Group ports within a range of interest at the top of the menu

key.description: Lowest port number in the watched range

key.name: watch-high
key.description: Highest port number in the watched range
